programme: Two opposing arms and one fate factor. FOSL2 (84/104), JUND and EGR1 with REL form the AP-1 plus NF-kB inflammatory arm that oxidant and cigarette-smoke exposure activates; PPARG, NR1H2 (LXR beta) and ESRRG form the lipid- and energy-sensing nuclear receptor arm that restrains it. TCF21 is the third element: the coronary artery disease GWAS gene that sets smooth muscle and fibroblast fate. MITF, ASCL1, HOXC6 and CDX1 are outside the module.
role_in_a: TCF21 is one of the best-validated coronary artery disease risk genes, controlling the fibromyocyte state of plaque smooth muscle cells, and AP-1/NF-kB-driven monocyte activation with impaired LXR/PPARG-dependent cholesterol handling is the core of atherogenesis.
role_in_b: In COPD the same AP-1/NF-kB arm carries the oxidant-driven inflammatory response of airway epithelium and macrophages, PPARG and LXR restrain it, and TCF21 marks the fibroblast populations involved in airway remodelling.
shared_axis: Cigarette smoke is the shared exposure and this is the programme it acts through: sustained AP-1/NF-kB inflammatory transcription with failing nuclear-receptor restraint, in vessel wall and airway respectively, with TCF21 setting the mesenchymal response in both.
reasoning: The comorbidity of COPD and cardiovascular disease and its basis in shared smoking exposure and systemic inflammation is textbook, and the factors listed are the ones that axis is built from rather than a restatement of it. TCF21 appearing alongside them is the detail that makes this more than generic inflammation. Confidence is medium rather than high because AP-1 and NF-kB members are high-degree and easy to recover, so part of the signal may be non-specific.
support: 31359001 — TCF21, a coronary artery disease risk gene, controls the phenotypic modulation of plaque smooth muscle cells.
how_to_falsify: AP-1 and NF-kB members are high-degree and easy to recover, so a sceptic will say the method found generic inflammation and TCF21 by luck. The reply is to show TCF21 is not recovered in the other 24 cardiovascular pairs at comparable rank.
caveats: Tissue pairing is blood | lung. 104 patient-group combinations from 4 independent cohort pairs.
